introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently bring your chin down to your chest.\n\nInhale, slowly look up towards the ceiling. Repeat.
name: UP & DOWN NODS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't turn your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you bend forward, and inhale as you extend back.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently turn your head to the left.\n\nInhale, return to center. Switch sides and repeat.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TURNS

tips.text: Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you turn to each side, and inhale as you return to center.

introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently tilt your head towards your left shoulder.\n\nInhale, return to center. Switch sides and repeat.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you tilt to each side, and inhale as you return to center.

introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms clockwise in big circles.
name: OVERHEAD ARM CLOCKWISE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms counterclockwise in big circles.
name: OVERHEAD ARM COUNTERCLOCKWISE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Bend your elbows at 90 degrees. Turn your palms up, clench your fists with your thumbs pointed outward.\n\nExhale, rotate your forearms outward horizontally. Inhale as you return to the starting position. Repeat.
name: SHOULDER OUTWARD ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when rotating your forearms outward, and inhale when bringing them back.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades when rotating outward.
Please always keep your shoulders flat.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.
name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your left leg straight on the ground, and your right leg bent with your right foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your left leg and lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Lie flat down on your back with your right leg straight on the ground, and your left leg bent with your left foot flat on the ground. \n\nTighten your right leg and Lift it straight up until your thighs are parallel, then slowly lower it down.
name: STRAIGHT LEG RAISE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight and tight during the exercise.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bend your arms forward and rest your hands gently behind your head.

Inhale, gently arch your lower back, allowing a subtle lift while keeping your tailbone grounded. Exhale as you press your lower back into the mat, closing the gap.

Repeat with smooth and steady breaths.
name: THE NO-GAP

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes and flatten your lower back on the ground.
This exercise can help fix the anterior pelvic tilt.
Inhale to return and relax your back. Exhale to press your lower back down.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Kneel down and sit back on your heels. Support your hands on the floor in front of you. 

Push your pelvis forward, and keep your lumbar region still. 

Inhale, and round your upper back. Exhale, and pull your chest out. Repeat the exercise.
name: THORACIC SPINE CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lumbar region still during exercise.
Inhale as you round your upper back, and exhale as you pull your chest out.
This exercise can mobilize your upper back.

introduce:
Start on your knees and elbows. Place your elbows under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. 

Drop your head on the floor, and put your hands on the top of your head. Round your spine while keeping your upper back still. 

Inhale, and drop your pelvis down. Exhale, and round your spine. Repeat the exercise.
name: LUMBAR CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper back still during exercise.
Inhale as you drop your pelvis down, and exhale as you round your spine.
This exercise can mobilize your lumbar spine.
